text: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region’s Insurance‑Linked Securities (ILS) Regulatory Regime and Pilot ILS Grant Scheme is a government-led initiative aimed at facilitating the issuance of insurance-linked securities, such as catastrophe bonds, in Hong Kong. The initiative includes a dedicated regulatory framework and a Pilot ILS Grant Scheme that provides financial and developmental support to lower barriers for issuance and nurture talent. This initiative is part of Hong Kong's strategy to strengthen its status as a global risk management center and financial hub.
